description: Send a sample Hyperliquid liquidation, marked as a test, to an alert's destination now and report whether it arrived (delivered true or false, with the destination's answer). A delivered test switches a disabled alert back on. One test per alert every 10 seconds.

id.description: Alert id from create_liquidation_alert or list_liquidation_alerts

name: test_liquidation_alert

delivered.description: Whether the destination accepted the test message

error.description: The destination's answer when it was not delivered

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

title: Test liquidation alert
